description: This PHP class 'EndpointGetAllResult' extends 'AbstractEndpointResult' and is used to normalize results for an API endpoint, including handling collections with 'CollectionNormalizable'. It is part of the OrangeHRM system and marked as deprecated.

classes.name: EndpointGetAllResult
classes.description: A class for normalizing the results of a specific API endpoint, potentially handling collections.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes the data, returning a normalized object or array depending on whether the model class implements 'CollectionNormalizable'.
